shorts_extract.hook: Four cards ('E — K — 4 — 7') fool 90% of educated adults — until a pub bouncer rule flips accuracy to 80% and exposes how confirmation bias really works.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Wason (1966/1968): <10% pick E & 7 while ~50% pick E & 4, plus Wason's 1960 '2-4-6' confirmation trap.
shorts_extract.twist: Why 'If Beer to Over 21' (`Beer` + `16`) jumps to 80% accuracy AND Evans's 'matching bias' twist.
